title: HB 3691 (89R): Relating to electronic submission of an application for an early voting ballot by mail by certain persons.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id) not stated.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id)
(section) SECTION 3 (adds Election Code 84.0091(b))
(quote) (b) The program implemented under Subsection (a) must require a person 65 years of age or older to provide the following information before allowing the person to complete an application for an early voting ballot by mail: (1) the person's name and voter registration number or registration address; (2) the person's driver's license number or personal identification card number issued by the Department of Public Safety; and (3) the last four digits of the person's social security number.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(other) Sec 1 (84.001(b), (d)): application in ink on paper still required except as provided by new 84.0091; electronic or photocopied signature not permitted except under 84.0091; application submitted to the early voting clerk (the words 'by mail' removed).
(other) Sec 2 (84.007(a)): cross-reference to 84.0091.
(other) Sec 3 (84.0091(a)): secretary of state program for persons 65 or older to complete a mail ballot application online from the state website and the county website, with electronic signature, delivery to the early voting clerk and status check.
(other) Sec 4: effective September 1, 2025.
